lines: Alas, as always.
Yawns arise in the passing days.
Through the clamorous night, today as well.
Morning falls upon Shibuya's streets.
Somehow hollow.
That feeling.
It's boring.
But that's fine.
That's how it is.
This is enough.
Unwittingly I hid it.
Let your true voice resonate, see.
Even if I pretend not to see.
It is certainly there.
Alas, I draw as I feel.
With the color I chose myself.
On a morning cloaked in sleepy air.
I arrived at a blue world.
I say I love what I love.
It terrifies me, yet I cannot help it.
My true self.
I felt I had met it.
Alas, the more I reach out.
The farther it goes.
Today, too, things do not go as I wish.
Again I flail hurriedly.
Even the resentful feeling is merely pitiful.
Tears fall.
The deeper I step in, the more it hurts.
It also becomes painful.
Alas, I move as I feel.
On this road I chose myself.
In the night when heavy lids rub.
A blue vow I clung to.
Continuing what I love.
It is not merely fun.
I can truly do it.
I become uneasy, though.
Alas, as many sheets as you like, see, as many as you like.
Because I lack confidence, I have been drawing.
Alas, as many times as you like, see, as many times as you like.
What I have piled up becomes my weapon.
Even if I look around, no matter who I compare to.
What is it that only I can do?
Even now I have no confidence, yet.
A feeling I have never felt.
A yearning I was unaware of.
Stepping forward that day.
All this pain I felt for the first time.
By confronting what I love.
I touched a still small light.
It's okay, let's go, the rest is just to enjoy.
Alas, I draw betting everything.
In a color only I can produce.
Running onward both morning and night.
The blue light I discovered.
Facing what I love.
Even now it's frightening.
Now I am no longer the transparent me of that day.
Alas, as I am.
I am irreplaceable.
Unwittingly I hid it.
Let your true voice resonate, see.
Even if I pretend not to see.
It is certainly there now, still there.
Unwittingly I hid it.
Let your true voice resonate, now.
Even if I pretend not to see.
It is certainly within you.
